covers.name: BetterWorkbench
covers.prompt: Generate ONE standalone square Steam Workshop cover, full bleed, no contact sheet, no panels, no gutter. Reference image 1 is the approved art-direction board: match its polished bright Palworld-style 3D promotional rendering, clean smooth materials, saturated daylight, coherent sunlight and bold white fantasy typography with angular notches and small organic flourishes. Main feature illustration upper 72%, title lower 28% with subtle dark shading, strong tiny-thumbnail readability. Small exact "PALWORLD MOD" upper left. Below the English title a thin white horizontal rule with a small central hollow diamond, below that the exact Chinese subtitle in heavy clean angular white Chinese lettering. No other text, no watermark. Keep text inside generous safe margins. Match upper-left cover in reference 1. Wooden crafting workbench, hammer, warm glowing amber ingots, wood and ore following a clear circular golden arrow path above the bench. Recognizable cute round Lamball on right with fluffy white wool, dark face, brown curled horns, joyfully helping with crafting. Lush grassy base and distant dark blue futuristic tower. Gold theme. Exact English title on two lines "BETTER" / "WORKBENCH". Exact Chinese "更好的工作台". Preserve approved scene and composition.
